repeats.rationale: Two strongly conserved 26-residue repeats separated by a 12-aa linker, sharing 16 identical positions including a C-x8-C-x5-C-x3-H cysteine/histidine spacing, aromatic anchors (Y, F, Y, F), and an N-terminal +YKTELC motif.

Three dispersed 9-residue motifs located in the N- and C-terminal proline/serine-rich disordered regions, anchored by an invariant PPPPG core followed by a conserved hydrophobic residue (A/L) and P/G/L C-terminal positions.

Five dispersed copies of a strongly conserved 5-residue motif in the N-terminal P/S/E/A-enriched disordered region (residues 90-190), anchored by a dibasic +R dyad, invariant E at position 4, constrained [VTA] at position 3, and large aliphatic ψ at position 5.

Six conserved CxxC...Hxxx[HC] repeat units anchored by an N-terminal hydrophobic/aromatic residue ([FYM]), an invariant CxxC pair, a conserved internal [LF] position, and a C-terminal H(x){3,5}[HC] pair, arranged in an N-terminal cluster of four copies and a C-terminal cluster of two copies separated by 5-aa linkers within each cluster.

Six gapless 77-residue structured domain repeats separated by variable disordered linkers (28-171 aa), anchored by invariant L(1), V(5), F(9), A(16), P(26), V(39), G[LM]P(41-43), F+(48-49), P(51), Iψ(62-63), I(69), and F(71) positions across all six copies.

Twelve contiguous head-to-tail 28-residue structured-like repeats anchored by strictly invariant K3, C7, C10, F14, H23, and H27 positions along with strongly conserved hydrophobic ([YFC]5, [LF]20) and polar/charged linker residues.

Eleven 33-34 aa alpha-helical repeats arranged in tandem clusters with two internal linkers, anchored by strictly invariant A at position 18, conserved [AVF] at position 6, hydrophobic packing positions (ψ19, φ22), and frequent turn G13/P30-34 residues.

Head-to-tail 12-aa tandem duplication in the N-terminal disordered tail sharing 7 exact column anchors (LPPIV and RR) plus a conserved PA/[AS] segment (9/12 aligned identities), making chance occurrence implausible; the central amphipathic heptad rod (residues 68-223) is flagged separately as coiled_coil_heptad.
Four contiguous head-to-tail 26-residue repeats in a proline/acidic-rich disordered region sharing an invariant PV..K.EDG..EPEGTLPAE core and alternating TLLLS[SP] / APPPPP C-terminal hexapeptides.

Six tandem 22-25 aa structured repeats (head-to-tail with one 2-aa linker before the sixth copy) anchored by spaced aliphatic/hydrophobic positions (xLxψxx[NK]xφ), a conserved E[NDI]ψ segment, and a C-terminal L[RDN] motif.

Three dispersed copies of a conserved proline-rich motif within the disordered C-terminal region featuring an invariant PLP core and C-terminal R anchor flanked by tightly constrained [AP] and [PQ] positions.

Four 66-67 aa structured-like repeats separated by short variable linkers (6-18 aa), anchored by invariant A2, L5, A8, GT, I20, R26, and G56 positions alongside conserved acidic, aromatic, and hydrophobic core columns.

Four well-conserved 29-37 aa structured-like repeats in the C-terminal region (separated by variable segments), defined by a conserved [LFW]SP turn motif, a central φφ[ASV] hydrophobic patch, and a C-terminal [GS]xψxψ[WH]x[LV]x core.

Nine head-to-tail tandem repeats of 22-33 residues spanning positions 71-310, each anchored at its N-terminus by a strict [LV]xx[LI]xψ aliphatic core motif followed by a variable-length hydrophobic-containing segment.

Three contiguous 33-residue tandem repeats in the C-terminal region (positions 641-739) featuring invariant PL, A, and N anchors alongside conserved [VT], [GA], [FL][FL], and C-terminal acidic positions.
